label: Bible Study
prompt: And all the _____ of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD'S: it is holy unto the LORD.
verse: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD'S: it is holy unto the LORD.
note: The tithe — a tenth of the harvest, belonging to the LORD before the farmer ever counts it.

label: Warm-Up Word
note: Four little words open the last chapter of Hebrews: keep the brotherly love going.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered _____, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
verse: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
note: Paul's résumé of hardships: thrice beaten with rods, once stoned, three shipwrecks, and a night and a day in the deep.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is _____?
verse: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Why askest thou thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
note: Samson's father asked the angel's name and was refused — then the angel rose up in the altar's flame.

label: Don't Play With Me
